decisive_items: High titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody
response.rationale: Rheumatoid meningitis is supported by high-titer CCP antibody, leptomeningeal enhancement, and biopsy showing lymphoplasmacytic exudate with giant cells, without vasculitis or infection. R4 lacks granulomas and has no systemic sarcoidosis evidence; R3 has oligoclonal bands but biopsy and clinical course are atypical; R2 is excluded by biopsy showing no vasculitis.

rejected.why: Oligoclonal bands correspond to serum, no acute infarct, and biopsy findings are not demyelinating; clinical relapsing-remitting pattern is less specific.
No non-caseating granulomas on biopsy, and no systemic sarcoidosis features; arachnoid enhancement is also seen in rheumatoid meningitis.
Brain biopsy explicitly shows no evidence of vasculitis, and MRA is normal.
